COORDINATOR HOLD (Wave 1 verification): page style 1 is NOT shipped — it shares its shape (2 letters + 9 digits + 1 letter) with held page style 3, so a style-3 serial would mis-decode under style 1 with a wrong week/year; shipping it would violate the never-guess rule. Unblocker: the style-3 chart (FEDDERS-3-Serial-Number.jpg) establishing a distinguishing rule. Page styles 3, 4 and 5 are held for the image pass (month/year letters chart-only).

styles.notes: Page example shown as '02J-60002' (dash stripped by normalization). Year = 1st & 2nd characters (digits). Month = 3rd character letter per chart image FEDDERS-2-Serial-Number.jpg, held for the image pass, so year-only.
